children: Crowwd raises Rs 2.5 crore in angel funding at a Rs 50 crore valuation to expand wealth-tech infrastructure and launch mutual fund distribution
Crowwd, an investing platform focused on behavioural personalisation, has raised Rs 2.5 crore in an angel funding round at a valuation of around Rs 50 crore

The round saw participation from more than 30 investors, including Dr Ritesh Malik, Founder of Innov8; Three Words Capital; Sachin Panwar; Deepak Raina and Gaurav Nagar, Co-founders of YogaCleanAir; France-based Hexa Startup Studio; Somya Satsangi, Independent Director at Dr Lal PathLabs; and Sachin Gupta, Managing Director of Share India Securities

The company said the funding will support the expansion of its platform from an investor-focused social community into a wealth-tech platform with investment capabilities. Crowwd is preparing to launch an in-app mutual fund distribution platform and is registered with the Association of Mutual Funds in India as a Mutual Fund Distributor

“Crowwd began as an investor community and developed its behavioural framework around how individuals approach investing,” said Ajitesh Gupta, Co-Founder and CEO of Crowwd. “With this round, we are focusing on adding investment access to the platform, beginning with mutual fund distribution and building the technology and capabilities required for the next phase”

Crowwd's platform uses its proprietary Investor DNA framework, which categorises investors into six behavioural profiles based on their investing patterns. The company plans to incorporate this framework into its investment products and services alongside its financial content and investor community

The fresh capital will be used to develop and scale Crowwd's wealth-tech infrastructure, acquire and integrate a brokerage platform, expand mutual fund distribution, and strengthen its technology, compliance and operational capabilities
Mutual fund distribution will initially form the core of the company's revenue model.
